lines.text: Many learners say: He is more tall than me.
Better: He is taller than me.
Younger! She is younger than me.

data.wrong: He is more tall than me.

native.tip: Con adjetivos cortos añade “-er”: “taller”. “More” es para palabras largas.
native.caption: En español “más alto”, pero en inglés cambia 😎 No digas “He is more tall than me.”, sino “He is taller than me.”. ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “younger”. Adjetivo corto + “-er”. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “more tall”? It is “taller”
en.tip: With short adjectives add “-er”: “taller”. “More” is for long words.
en.caption: In Spanish “más alto”, but English changes. Do not say “He is more tall than me.”, say “He is taller than me.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
